name: OGAM
tagline: Offline AI that chats, sees, speaks and draws
description:
OGAM packs a lot of AI into one app that works with no internet at all. You can chat with a model, ask about a photo, talk out loud, listen to answers and even make pictures — all running on the phone itself.

Models are downloaded once and then stay on your device, so nothing you type or say leaves it. Handy on a plane, in the mountains, or any time you'd rather not send your words to a server.
